evidence: unreadable: In seg2:start the caption "50% lands in" is faint grey on beige sand and nearly disappears on a phone. In seg4:mid a falling bottle covers "2060 (projected)".

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start to seg2:end show a giant bottle packed with plastic almost to its "full" line under the words "Only 9%". The 9% is really a small crate at the bottom, and the 50% to dumps and 22% elsewhere from the narration are never drawn. Data stands beside a valve wheel and only touches it at seg2:end.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene draws a filling vessel and says nothing about where the rest goes. Its biggest object reads as nearly full, which is the opposite of the claim, and the three-way split the narration states has no picture.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the whole stream splitting three ways in proportion: a thin 9% trickle into the recycling crate, a fat 50% chute into a landfill heap and a 22% spill escaping into the scene. Data should be the one turning the valve that releases the flow, so the 9% trickle looks visibly tiny next to the dump.
